headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs. The Pirates routed the Marlins 13-1 behind a historic performance from Rafael Flores Jr., who hit 2 home runs and drove in 6 runs. Braxton Ashcraft pitched a complete game, striking out 10 and allowing just 1 earned run.

Several players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Davis Martin, a right-handed pitcher for the Chicago White Sox, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. Matt Chapman, a third baseman for the San Francisco Giants, has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain. Trevor McDonald, a right-handed pitcher for the San Francisco Giants, has also been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right elbow strain.

In roster movement, Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. Additionally, the Miami Marlins traded 1B Jacob Berry to the Kansas City Royals.
